_meta.note: KAS 0.66.58 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.33.1 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id is replaced with a fixed synthetic value, every engine-minted uuid with a numbered synthetic one, the scratch work dir reads as /work and the home directory as ~. Host inventory frames are omitted (_kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/policy/changed, available_commands_update, config_option_update, every session_info_update, and every _kiro/tools/didChange but the last, which follows session/set_mode and lists the bound agent's tool tags). KAS's initialize carries no agentInfo, so no agent name is recorded. The session/new response is kept TRIMMED to sessionId, modes.currentModeId and the probe's own availableModes entry; the rest lists the host's agents and entitlements. A MARKDOWN agent file /work/.kiro/agents/probe-mr.md (YAML frontmatter name probe-mr, tools [read]; body: reply to anything with exactly the words markdown agent saffron) was read with acp.kas_agents.load_agent_spec, projected with build_kas_custom_agents, sent as _meta.kiro.customAgents on session/new and activated with session/set_mode `probe-mr` (its empty result is the third response). The last _kiro/tools/didChange lists only the read tag. Asked `Say hello.`, the model answered markdown agent saffron, so the markdown body reached the model as its prompt. On KAS 0.66.43 (kiro-cli 2.32.0) the same probe was answered with a plain greeting.
